faq.q: What is the smallest lot I can create in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: It depends on the zone under Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019: RS-1 requires 668.0 m² (18.0 m width, 27.0 m depth), RS-2 requires 0.4 ha, RS-3 requires 0.8 ha or 2.0 ha depending on the zone text, and the agricultural zones run from A-1 at 2.0 ha to A-3 at 8.0 ha — and ALR land also needs Agricultural Land Commission permission to subdivide outside limited exceptions.

faq.q: Can I build a second home on a rural Maple Ridge lot?
faq.a: On ALR land, one additional detached residence is permitted under the ALC frame where conditions are met — 90 m² or less on parcels of 40 ha or smaller, 186 m² or less on larger parcels — with the principal residence capped at 500 m² and any suite inside it; City bylaws must also permit it, and off-reserve lots follow the City's suite and SSMUH rules instead.
